page: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud server built on 64-bit ARM architecture. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running on Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processors clocked at 3.4 GHz, backed by 128 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates 256 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, along with 1888 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The configuration includes hardware AES cryptographic support without GPU acceleration.

Benchmark evaluations reveal exceptional memory subsystem throughput and database execution efficiency. The instance achieved top-tier ratings in PassMark memory testing and PassMark database operations, reinforced by uncached memory read bandwidth of 449.0 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 188.31 GB/sec. Parallel compute benchmarks such as Geekbench multi-core (20,088) and stress-ng multi-core (66,297.85) placed in the upper quartile, supporting high-throughput workloads like Clang compilation and multi-threaded decompression. Additionally, Redis testing recorded 61.82 million SET operations per second alongside 56.14 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

Single-thread compute benchmarks and large language model inference indicate architectural tradeoffs. Single-core tests such as Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core placed in the median tier. For machine learning, large language model prompt processing on 70B models placed in the lowest decile, while smaller LLM inferences remained average. The lack of x86 vector extensions such as AVX-512 restricts specialized legacy numeric code paths.

The E32pds_v6 exhibits strong qualitative resource efficiency for memory-bound systems by pairing dense memory and fast local NVMe storage with power-efficient ARM silicon. It is well suited for enterprise relational databases, distributed in-memory caches, transactional stores, and parallel software build pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs on 32 physical cores powered by the 64-bit ARM Neoverse-N2 architecture operating at 3.4 GHz. It integrates 256 GB of RAM, offering an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside 1888 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier memory bandwidth with uncached read speeds of 449.0 GB/sec and write speeds of 188.31 GB/sec, translating into leading results in PassMark database operations and over 61 million Redis SET operations per second. Multi-core performance across Geekbench and stress-ng ranks in the upper quartile, whereas single-core metrics and heavy large language model prompt processing place in average to lower tiers. The architecture exhibits balanced resource efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The E32pds_v6 is suited for in-memory databases, key-value stores, distributed analytics, and large-scale compilation tasks requiring high memory density.
